flagle.title: Flagle - Guess the Flag & Learn Geography
flagle.slogan: Expand Your World Knowledge with Flagle
flagle.description: Flagle is an educational guessing game that challenges you to identify hidden flags while learning about countries. With six attempts, uncover the flag piece by piece and receive geographical hints to improve your skills. Flagle makes learning geography fun and engaging. Start playing Flagle today and explore the world!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Flagle is an educational guessing game designed to expand your knowledge about countries and the world. Guess the hidden flag and receive geographical hints to improve your skills.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Guess the country whose flag is hidden.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Use no more than six attempts.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Unlock another part of the hidden flag with each unsuccessful guess.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Flagle helps you learn about countries and their flags.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Guess the hidden flag in six attempts or less.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Receive geographical hints to guide your guesses.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Flagle makes learning geography fun and interactive.
